input:
We are running a real-time VM with a hardware watchdog. The VM uses GICv4.2 vNMI to deliver non-maskable virtual interrupts directly without trap-and-emulate. The guest watchdog timer fires but the virtual NMI is never delivered inside the guest.

Host dmesg:
  [  0.100] GICv4.2 detected, vNMI support enabled
  [  0.200] kvm: vgic-v4: ITS VMAPP for vPE 0 configured (vNMI=0)
  [  0.201] kvm: vgic: GICv4.2 vNMI delivery bit NOT set for vPE 0

Guest dmesg:
  (no NMI received, guest watchdog timeout, soft lockup)

KVM config:
  CONFIG_KVM_ARM_VGIC_V4=y
  GIC hardware: GICv4.2 confirmed via GICD_TYPER2.nASSGIcap

The ITS VMAPP command was issued but the vNMI delivery bit was not set. What is the correct sequence to enable vNMI delivery for a vPE via the ITS VMAPP/VMOVP command interface?
